Questions

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Which platforms do you build on?

We recommend the platform that suits your team — from hand-built static sites and headless CMS setups to WordPress and Webflow — rather than forcing one tool on every project.

Will my website be optimised for search?

Yes. Every build ships with clean semantic markup, fast load times, metadata, structured data and a sitemap, so it is ready to be found.

Can we update the website ourselves?

Yes. We set up an editing workflow your team is comfortable with and hand over with training.
